title: Guinness Brewery, St. James’s Gate
geometryBasis: The NIAH identifies the main entrance and paired lodges as one architectural group. The named gate and two matching building footprints supply the coordinate, north-facing axis, width and depths.
sectionBasis: The original Commons CC0 close photograph gives the gate opening proportions, granite surrounds, render, door design, sign position, parapet, date panels and east lodge return. The official inventory records the three-storey lodges, sash types, hipped roof fronts and east chimney.
limitations: The model covers the main James’s Street entrance and its gate lodges. The larger operating brewery and separate Storehouse building are beyond this model’s footprint.
Roof lines, glazing reflections, the carved keystone head and door joinery are simplified. The date panels represent the standing annual signage.
